# Third-party art (originals)

Downloaded packs are kept here locally but **not committed** (they are large and can be downloaded again).
What the game actually uses is exported to `Art/Characters/...` and imported into `Content/CountriesIRL/...`.

| Pack | Source | License | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Modular Character Outfits - Fantasy [Standard] | https://quaternius.com (also on Fab) | CC0 1.0 (public domain) | Male Peasant outfit on the humanoid body (`Art/Characters/Outfits/SKM_Outfit_MalePeasant.glb`) |

To rebuild from the originals, download the pack and extract it into this folder under its own name.
The outfits are made for Quaternius' Universal Base Character rig (UE-mannequin bone names, T-pose);
they're animated from the UE mannequin through `RTG_Manny_To_QuaterniusOutfit`.
